items.title: Wendell Brunious interviewed by Michael Woods, Los Angeles, California, September 3, 1995 [interview 1 of 2]
items.q: And I mean like when you hear Doc Cheatham man, you don’t want to hear any more trumpet than that.

ctx.x: He is a killer. But he grew up, he played in those New Orleans brass bands, and he, you know, he used to come around me a lot and then he went to a little school in New Orleans called NOCA, the New Orleans Center for the Creative Arts. And that brought him out. He learned his theory and this guy plays piano, he’s a great drummer, plays bass, his dad is a bass player. He plays bass like unbelievable. And he’s blowing the bell off of the trumpet. So there are exceptions to these things that I’m saying. But we’re…
A real musician, a jazz musician can swing at any tempo.
